units: meters, Y-up, right-handed. pos=[x,y,z]; Blender (x,y,z) -> (x,z,-y). rotY in radians about +Y (three.js convention). Near = +z, far (mountains) = -z.

camera.ease: smoothstep per segment (view_map.html ?cam=t uses the same)

roadPath.note: right-hand lane centre of the loop road, counter-clockwise seen from above; car_a with drive=true starts on it. Car forward axis is +x at rotY=0. Suggested speed 5 to 6 m/s.
